key_difference: (D) adds a separate decodeForLocalFile() that re-decodes valid percent-encoded UTF-8 and ignores characters that were not percent-encoded, whereas (B) extends the existing decode() to fail on any decoded byte >= 0x80 (valid UTF-8 is already stored decoded in QUrl) and, on Windows, also rejects literal backslashes, which QUrl stores in decoded form and which (D) therefore lets through unchecked.
